how: Calls recruit pixel work through all-hands summons, national encouragement, and specific flag repairs.
An attempted attacker judges the addressed group too few, without measuring the strength of the wider national effort.
Recruitment addresses existing flags attributed partly to another venue, leaving their original starter unidentified.
Short thanks and reassurance acknowledge a pact announcement without asking for anything back.
Participants propose integrating an ostehøvel and putting a chess pawn inside the flag.
Participants locate existing flags and report incorrect proportions in the placed work.
Anchor coordinates and a starting corner make the proposed pixel work findable and actionable.
Local informal coordination must allow publicly reported decided order through a Discord peace vote, without treating the unseen vote as independently verified.
The coded record does not report machine placing, and accounts of unseen Discord activity cannot establish its absence there.
A speaker explicitly prioritises keeping the existing flag defensible over enlarging its territory.
A participant attributes unwanted expansion to people taking over Discord, preserving the explanation as a claim rather than a verified cause.
Visitors appeal for flags and artwork to be spared, establishing requests for restraint without establishing that builders comply.
An appeal can obtain reassurance or an explicit refusal, so seeking restraint must remain distinct from achieving it.
Participants publicly affirm a pact and describe a changed flag plan as reassurance to a neighbour.
Incoming diplomats must first locate the builders' existing venue or diplomatic channel before treating the receiving subreddit as a negotiating party.
The receiving subreddit and the reported builders must be distinguished before national address or first-person claims are attributed to a room-wide negotiating actor.
Self-described ambassadors carry requests between venues, with one proposer reporting which national subreddits have been contacted.
Participants call for Icelandic help, announce help accompanying a pact, and offer maintenance in exchange for space.
A joint heart is proposed among four flags and a shared heart is reported maintained, without establishing a coalition council.
An ally and a respondent remember their friendship lasting through the event, establishing a reported alliance rather than its formation process.
A would-be guest asks permission to build inside claimed space and receives a host-like refusal followed by withdrawal.
Hosting must include refused admission without presuming either a resident guest work or the respondent's authority over all placers.
Language distinctions, venue corrections, and blame for expansion do not establish a dispute over who can bind placers to an agreement.
A visitor's agreement to look elsewhere after refusal does not establish the receiving room relocating an erased work.
Participants borrow national sovereignty, game land claims, and migration language to perform their canvas dispute.
Borrowed national and game idioms establish situated joking but do not by themselves establish an inherited collective belief or pre-canvas quarrel.
Naming national attack targets does not establish a quarrel carried into the event from before the canvas.
The attack call names Swedes without explaining a prior tie as its reason, so inherited rivalry cannot be decided from this evidence.
Turning a dismissal about a flag into a joke that the speaker is a flag creates local play without requiring inherited lore or a rival-room contest.
Participants defend the tourist and English-language purpose of the venue by redirecting canvas discussion and rejecting spam.
Referrals identify an already existing coordinating subreddit and do not establish the opening of a new canvas subreddit.
Boundary replies forward visitors to an existing builders' venue or diplomatic channel while preserving a route for their unresolved business.
Correcting the language and operational venue of discussion does not establish a dispute over who may commit the group to treaties.
An incoming canvas complaint is answered by defending the receiving subreddit's purpose and locating the flag builders elsewhere.
Flag jokes and explanations of the travel sub do not establish a host-wide April Fools takeover or licence.
Participants mark the effort after placement by honouring their alliance and celebrating friendship lasting to the ending.
A brief retrospective records that the friendship survived until the game ended without documenting the final canvas image.
Celebrating friendship through the ending supplies no decision to continue a tie or project afterward.
The post-event alliance remembrance supplies no dispute over a cleaned canvas, preferred version, or corrected historical account.
Participants propose converting another nation's flag and claim space that neighbours want preserved.
Calls, individual attempts, and complaints about national builders must not be silently aggregated into implemented attacks by the receiving subreddit.
Competing sovereign and de-jure land claims perform a small contest in talk without establishing a continuing raid or victory.
Repair instructions show coordination but cannot establish that the preceding call caused additional placing.
The visible calls address an already existing flag attributed to another venue, leaving the starter-to-call mechanism unresolved.
State reports and a defence proposal coexist without a passage establishing that completed construction generated upkeep.
Separate defence and border appeals do not establish that maintenance pressure caused negotiation.
A reassurance about changed expansion and a treaty-breaking complaint do not show a settled border causing restraint.
Defence talk and an unseen Discord account cannot establish escalation from upkeep to machine placing.
The alliance celebration does not name a preceding completion report as its occasion.
Celebration and remembrance coexist in one turn without establishing a transition from marking the work to preserving its record.
The remembered friendship is not followed in the coded record by a decision about lasting ties or successor work.
A shortage judgement and a visitor's withdrawal occur in different exchanges without evidence that the shortage caused a move.
Proportions and corner instructions are visible, but no cited concept shows a posted template settling the design discussion.
Bare acknowledgements answer a pact announcement rather than establishing the theorised recruitment-call acceptance mechanism.
A request for help and a shortage assessment do not establish maintenance strain generating reciprocal help.
A pact and help can be announced together while the unseen bargaining history leaves their causal dependence unresolved.
The opening summons may already be an attack call, so recruitment and contention need not await a locally observed building phase.
Restraint may be sought through an outsider's appeal answered with reassurance elsewhere, rather than members refusing the original attack call in its own thread.
A treaty-breaking complaint supplies no demonstrated path from an earlier attack call to the negotiation that produced the treaty.
Competing land-claim jokes do not identify an earlier attack as the cause of their contest in talk.
Remembering an alliance does not establish shared attack pressure as the cause of its formation.
Boundary enforcement can answer incoming diplomatic complaints, without evidence that the host's recruitment calls generated those visitors or their grievances.
The acknowledged pact supplies no observed challenge to agreement-making authority, while venue corrections address another issue.
